"""Independent vectorized saved-operand mechanics; no engine or producer imports."""
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib,json,math,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
ROOT=Path('/Users/nilakarthikesan/.codex/worktrees/partner-simulation-review/grasp-failure-prediction')
BASE=ROOT/'research_artifacts/manosim_compliant_contact_dynamics_2026-10-15_v1'
FREEZE='5410cf8380f944a07fa7e62669fc4b6f5578ed55'
PSHA='13b2d8e4ad214d325f7605f1ee3bafa477bebe77f8769a1fd6624fb19cc1a03b'
FLAGS=('native_contact_law_qualified','articulated_MANO_dynamics_validated','real_hand_physical_calibration','collection_or_training_allowed')
M=.2;R=.01;G=9.81

def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def read(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def arrays(p):
 with np.load(p,allow_pickle=False) as z:return {k:z[k] for k in z.files}
def need(ok,msg):
 if not bool(ok):raise ValueError(msg)
def git(*a):return subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(ROOT),*a])
def verify(bindings):
 for path,value in bindings.items():need(sha(path)==value,'Bound input/source changed '+path)
def same(a,b,msg):need(np.array_equal(a,b),msg)
def close(a,b,msg,atol=1e-11,rtol=1e-12):
 a,b=np.asarray(a),np.asarray(b);need(a.shape==b.shape and np.isfinite(a).all() and np.isfinite(b).all(),msg+' finite/shape')
 error=float(np.max(np.abs(a-b),initial=0));need(np.all(np.abs(a-b)<=atol+rtol*np.abs(b)),msg);return error

def law_from_operands(a,parameters,compiled):
 p,v=a['position_start_m'],a['velocity_start_m_s'];gap=p[:,2]-R;delta=np.maximum(0.,-gap)
 k,c,mu,s=(parameters[n] for n in ('stiffness_n_per_m','damping_ns_per_m','friction','friction_speed_m_per_s'))
 normal=np.where(gap<0,np.maximum(0.,k*delta-c*v[:,2]),0.)
 vt=v.copy();vt[:,2]=0.;ft=-mu*normal[:,None]*vt/np.sqrt(np.sum(vt*vt,axis=1)+s*s)[:,None]
 force=ft.copy();force[:,2]+=normal
 point=p.copy();point[:,2]-=R;opposite=-force
 J=compiled['hand_point_J'];OJ=compiled['static_object_point_J']
 same(J,np.column_stack([np.eye(3),np.zeros((3,48))]),'Literal3translation subset of51J')
 same(OJ,np.zeros((3,1)),'Explicit static object Jacobian')
 hand_load=force@J;object_load=opposite@OJ
 energy=.5*k*delta**2;edot=-k*delta*v[:,2]
 nd=(normal-k*delta)*v[:,2];friction=np.sum(ft*vt,axis=1);power=np.sum(force*v,axis=1)
 expected=dict(signed_gap_m=gap,penetration_m=delta,normal_force_n=normal,hand_force_world_n=force,object_force_world_n=opposite,
  common_point_world_m=point,object_wrench_force_then_torque=np.column_stack([opposite,np.cross(point,opposite)]),
  hand_generalized_load=hand_load,object_generalized_load=object_load,relative_velocity_world_m_per_s=v,
  elastic_energy_j=energy,elastic_energy_rate_w=edot,mechanical_power_w=power,normal_dissipation_power_w=nd,friction_power_w=friction,
  power_identity_residual_w=edot+power-nd-friction)
 errors={key:close(a['law_'+key],value,'Independent compliant-law operand '+key) for key,value in expected.items()}
 for flag in ('native_hand_qualified','collection_allowed','training_allowed'):same(a['law_'+flag],np.zeros(len(p),bool),'Law cannot issue admission')
 need(np.all(normal>=0) and np.all(np.linalg.norm(ft,axis=1)<=mu*normal+1e-12),'Unilateral friction cone')
 need(np.max(nd,initial=0)<=1e-10 and np.max(friction,initial=0)<=1e-10,'Continuous law dissipation')
 return expected,errors

def integration_from_operands(case,a,law,parameters):
 h=case['dt_s'];p0,p1,v0,v1=(a[n] for n in ('position_start_m','position_endpoint_m','velocity_start_m_s','velocity_endpoint_m_s'));dv=v1-v0
 scale=.25 if case['kind']=='friction_low' else 1.5 if case['kind']=='friction_high' else 0.
 external=np.array([scale*.5*M*G,0.,0.]);total=law['hand_force_world_n']+external+np.array([0.,0.,M*case['gravity']])
 E0=law['elastic_energy_j'];gap1=p1[:,2]-R;E1=.5*parameters['stiffness_n_per_m']*np.maximum(0.,-gap1)**2
 mechanical0=.5*M*np.sum(v0*v0,axis=1)-M*case['gravity']*p0[:,2]+E0
 mechanical1=.5*M*np.sum(v1*v1,axis=1)-M*case['gravity']*p1[:,2]+E1
 externalwork=(p1-p0)@external;diss=h*(law['normal_dissipation_power_w']+law['friction_power_w']);rem=E1-E0-h*law['elastic_energy_rate_w']
 predicted=h*np.sum(law['hand_force_world_n']*dv,axis=1)-.5*M*np.sum(dv*dv,axis=1)+rem
 measured=mechanical1-mechanical0-externalwork-diss
 force_error=np.max(np.abs(M*dv/h-total),axis=1)
 work_error=np.abs(.5*M*(np.sum(v1*v1,axis=1)-np.sum(v0*v0,axis=1))-h*np.sum(total*.5*(v0+v1),axis=1))
 expected=dict(gap_start_m=law['signed_gap_m'],gap_endpoint_m=gap1,elastic_energy_endpoint_J=E1,
  external_force_N=np.broadcast_to(external,p0.shape),force_balance_N=force_error,discrete_impulse_work_error_J=work_error,
  euler_position_error_m=np.max(np.abs(p1-p0-h*v1),axis=1),mechanical_energy_start_J=mechanical0,mechanical_energy_endpoint_J=mechanical1,
  external_work_J=externalwork,continuous_dissipation_step_J=diss,elastic_discrete_remainder_J=rem,
  measured_integration_defect_J=measured,predicted_integration_defect_J=predicted,integration_energy_identity_error_J=np.abs(measured-predicted),
  linear_reaction_error_N=np.linalg.norm(law['hand_force_world_n']+law['object_force_world_n'],axis=1),
  angular_reaction_error_N_m=np.linalg.norm(np.cross(law['common_point_world_m'],law['hand_force_world_n'])+law['object_wrench_force_then_torque'][:,3:],axis=1),
  point_power_error_W=np.abs(np.sum(law['hand_force_world_n']*v0,axis=1)-law['mechanical_power_w']),gap_derivative_start_m_s=v0[:,2])
 errors={key:close(a[key],value,'Saved discrete accounting '+key) for key,value in expected.items()}
 close(a['start_qfrc_applied'],law['hand_generalized_load'][:,:3]+external,'Actually applied51subset load')
 close(a['start_qacc'],total/M,'Independent constantmass acceleration')
 close(v1,v0+h*a['start_qacc'],'Explicit force impulse to endpoint velocity',atol=1e-12)
 close(p1,p0+h*v1,'Semiimplicit Euler endpoint position',atol=1e-12)
 need(np.min(law['signed_gap_m'])>=-.005 and np.min(gap1)>=-.005,'Bounded penetration')
 return expected,errors

def assessment(case,a,L,parameters):
 failures=[];tail=a['endpoint_time_s']>=a['endpoint_time_s'][-1]-.1
 for key,limit in [('force_balance_N',L['force_balance_N']),('discrete_impulse_work_error_J',L['discrete_work_J']),('euler_position_error_m',L['discrete_freefall_m']),('integration_energy_identity_error_J',L['discrete_work_J']),('linear_reaction_error_N',L['action_reaction_N']),('angular_reaction_error_N_m',L['angular_action_reaction_N_m']),('point_power_error_W',L['virtual_work_W']),('law_power_identity_residual_w',L['virtual_work_W'])]:
  if np.max(np.abs(a[key]))>limit:failures.append(key)
 if np.any(a['engine_ncon']) or np.any(a['engine_nefc']) or np.any(a['engine_qfrc_constraint']):failures.append('stock_engine_contact')
 if np.any(a['law_normal_dissipation_power_w']>L['virtual_work_W']) or np.any(a['law_friction_power_w']>L['virtual_work_W']):failures.append('continuous_contact_dissipation')
 if np.any(a['law_normal_force_n']<0) or np.any(np.linalg.norm(a['law_hand_force_world_n'][:,:2],axis=1)>.5*a['law_normal_force_n']+L['action_reaction_N']):failures.append('unilateral_friction_bound')
 metrics={k:float(np.max(np.abs(a[k]))) for k in ('force_balance_N','discrete_impulse_work_error_J','integration_energy_identity_error_J','law_power_identity_residual_w')}
 metrics.update(maximum_absolute_integration_defect_J=float(np.max(np.abs(a['measured_integration_defect_J']))),sum_integration_defect_J=float(np.sum(a['measured_integration_defect_J'])),sum_continuous_dissipation_J=float(np.sum(a['continuous_dissipation_step_J'])))
 if case['kind']=='freefall':
  h,n=case['dt_s'],case['steps'];z=.5-.5*G*h*h*n*(n+1);v=-G*h*n;dz=abs(float(a['position_endpoint_m'][-1,2])-z);dv=abs(float(a['velocity_endpoint_m_s'][-1,2])-v)
  metrics.update(discrete_z_reference_m=z,discrete_v_reference_m_s=v,position_error_m=dz,velocity_error_m_s=dv)
  if dz>L['discrete_freefall_m'] or dv>L['discrete_freefall_m_s']:failures.append('freefall_discrete_reference')
 if case['kind']=='support':
  penetration=float(-np.mean(a['gap_start_m'][tail]));support=float(np.mean(a['law_normal_force_n'][tail]));speed=float(np.max(np.abs(a['velocity_endpoint_m_s'][tail])));reference=M*G/parameters['stiffness_n_per_m']
  metrics.update(rest_penetration_reference_m=reference,mean_penetration_m=penetration,mean_support_N=support,settled_speed_m_s=speed)
  if abs(penetration-reference)>L['support_penetration_m']:failures.append('analytic_penetration')
  if abs(support-M*G)>L['support_force_relative']*M*G:failures.append('gravity_support')
  if speed>L['settled_velocity_m_s']:failures.append('settling')
  if np.max(a['mechanical_energy_endpoint_J'])>M*G*.03*(1+L['impact_energy_gain_fraction']):failures.append('drop_impact_passivity')
 if case['kind'].startswith('friction'):
  vx=float(np.mean(a['velocity_endpoint_m_s'][tail,0]));metrics['mean_lateral_velocity_m_s']=vx
  if case['kind']=='friction_low':
   reference=parameters['friction_speed_m_per_s']*.25/math.sqrt(1-.25**2);metrics['regularized_creep_reference_m_s']=reference
   if abs(vx-reference)>max(L['regularized_creep_floor_m_s'],L['regularized_creep_relative']*reference):failures.append('regularized_creep_reference')
  else:
   accel=float(np.mean(a['start_qacc'][tail,0]));reference=.5*.5*G;metrics.update(mean_sliding_acceleration_m_s2=accel,sliding_acceleration_reference_m_s2=reference)
   if accel<=0 or abs(accel-reference)>L['sliding_acceleration_relative']*reference:failures.append('sliding_reference')
 return dict(status='PASS' if not failures else 'FAIL',failures=failures,metrics=metrics,physical_outcome=None,**{k:False for k in FLAGS})

def convergence(rows):
 out=[]
 for kind in ('freefall','support','friction_low','friction_high'):
  pair=[r for r in rows if r['case']['kind']==kind];x,y=[r['measurement'] for r in pair]
  pos=float(np.max(np.abs(np.asarray(x['final_position_world_m'])-np.asarray(y['final_position_world_m']))));vel=float(np.max(np.abs(np.asarray(x['final_velocity_world_m_s'])-np.asarray(y['final_velocity_world_m_s']))))
  if kind=='freefall':
   duration=pair[0]['case']['steps']*pair[0]['case']['dt_s'];reference=.5*G*duration*abs(pair[0]['case']['dt_s']-pair[1]['case']['dt_s']);passed=abs(pos-reference)<=1e-10 and vel<=1e-10;limits=dict(position_difference_reference_m=reference,position_reference_atol_m=1e-10,velocity_m_s=1e-10)
  else:
   pmax=5e-6 if kind=='support' else max(1e-4,.01*.5*(.5*.5*G)*.5**2) if kind=='friction_high' else 1e-4
   vmax=max(1e-3,.01*.5*.5*G*.5) if kind=='friction_high' else 1e-3
   passed=pos<=pmax and vel<=vmax;limits=dict(position_m=pmax,velocity_m_s=vmax)
  out.append(dict(kind=kind,status='PASS' if passed else 'FAIL',maximum_position_difference_m=pos,maximum_velocity_difference_m_s=vel,limits=limits))
 return out

def main():
 pp=BASE/'protocol.json';rp=BASE/'run_v1/report.json';need(rp.exists(),'Wait for completed actual report')
 need(sha(pp)==PSHA,'Protocol identity');p,r=read(pp),read(rp);need(len(p['bindings'])==1163 and len(p['tracked_sources'])==85,'Frozen closure cardinalities')
 need(git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==FREEZE,'HEAD hold before');verify(p['bindings'])
 for name in [*p['tracked_sources'],str(pp)]:need(hashlib.sha256(git('show',FREEZE+':'+str(Path(name).relative_to(ROOT)))).hexdigest()==sha(name),'Exact frozen source/Git blob')
 need(r['status']=='COMPLETED_COMPLIANT_CONTACT_BENCHMARK' and r['failure'] is None and r['final_binding_error'] is None,'Complete benchmark or preserve failure separately')
 need(r['freeze_commit']==FREEZE and r['protocol_sha256']==PSHA,'Actual report lineage')
 need(r['operation_counts']==dict(models=8,data=8,initial_forwards=8,steps=27000,law_evaluations=27000) and not r['forbidden_attempts'],'Exact bounded counts')
 need(len(r['cases'])==8 and [x['case'] for x in r['cases']]==p['plan'],'Allconditions exact order')
 need(r['elapsed_s']<=120 and not r['unindexed_array_paths'],'Budget/array inventory')
 need(r['matched_solid_reference']==[],'No invented stock-contact equivalence')
 for key in FLAGS:need(r[key] is False,'No native/physical/collection admission')
 need(r['physical_outcome'] is None,'No task outcome')
 inventory={};array_inventory={};cases=[];trace_by_id={};raw=Path(p['raw_root']).resolve()
 def item(path):
  path=Path(path).resolve();inventory[str(path)]=dict(sha256=sha(path),bytes=path.stat().st_size)
 for path in (pp,rp,BASE/'run_v1/STARTED.json',BASE/'run_v1/progress.json',BASE/'run_v1/worker.log'):item(path)
 started=read(BASE/'run_v1/STARTED.json');need(started==dict(protocol_sha256=PSHA,freeze_commit=FREEZE,status='STARTED_ONCE'),'Once-run marker')
 progress=read(BASE/'run_v1/progress.json');need(progress['counts']==r['operation_counts'] and progress['forbidden']==[],'Live counts agree')
 artifacts=r['artifacts'];seen=set();byfolder={}
 for info in artifacts:
  path=Path(info['path']);need(not path.is_symlink() and path.resolve().is_relative_to(raw) and path.resolve() not in seen,'Output containment/duplicates')
  need(sha(path)==info['sha256'] and path.stat().st_size==info['bytes'],'Creation-time output bytes');seen.add(path.resolve());item(path)
  byfolder.setdefault(path.parent.name,{})[path.name]=path
  if path.suffix=='.npz':array_inventory[str(path)]={k:dict(dtype=str(v.dtype),shape=list(v.shape),sha256=hashlib.sha256(np.ascontiguousarray(v).tobytes()).hexdigest()) for k,v in arrays(path).items()}
 need({x.resolve() for x in raw.rglob('*.npz')}=={x for x in seen if x.suffix=='.npz'},'All NPZ exactly indexed')
 for row in r['cases']:
  case=row['case'];need(row['status']=='MEASURED','Every fixture completed')
  for key in FLAGS:need(row[key] is False,'Child cannot grant admission')
  need(row['physical_outcome'] is None,'Child task outcome null')
  tracked,rawresult=Path(row['result_path']),Path(row['raw_result_path']);need(sha(tracked)==row['result_sha256'] and sha(rawresult)==row['raw_result_sha256'] and tracked.read_bytes()==rawresult.read_bytes(),'Original scalar copy identity');item(tracked);item(rawresult)
  scalar=read(tracked);need(scalar=={k:v for k,v in row.items() if k not in ('result_path','result_sha256','raw_result_path','raw_result_sha256')},'Scalar content exact')
  folder=byfolder[case['id']];need(set(folder)=={'fixture.xml','compiled_fixture.npz','trajectory.npz'},'Exactly threecreationartifacts per fixture')
  need(sha(folder['fixture.xml'])==p['xml_sha256'][case['id']],'Prospective fixture XML hash')
  compiled,a=arrays(folder['compiled_fixture.npz']),arrays(folder['trajectory.npz']);n=case['steps'];h=case['dt_s'];trace_by_id[case['id']]=a
  need(all(v.shape[0]==n and np.isfinite(v).all() for v in a.values()),'Every interval/channel finite and complete')
  same(compiled['joint_type'],np.full(3,2),'Three slide joint types');same(compiled['joint_axis'],np.eye(3),'Named world axes');same(compiled['joint_qpos_address'],np.arange(3),'Qpos order');same(compiled['joint_dof_address'],np.arange(3),'DOF order')
  same(compiled['body_mass_kg'],np.array([0.,M]),'Literal mass inventory');same(compiled['gravity_m_s2'],np.array([0.,0.,case['gravity']]),'Gravity');need(float(compiled['timestep_s'])==h,'Timestep')
  close(a['endpoint_time_s']-a['start_time_s'],np.full(n,h),'Every interval clock',atol=1e-12)
  close(a['endpoint_time_s'],np.arange(1,n+1)*h,'Full horizon clock',atol=1e-12)
  close(a['start_time_s'][1:],a['endpoint_time_s'][:-1],'Contiguous clocks',atol=1e-12)
  same(a['position_start_m'][1:],a['position_endpoint_m'][:-1],'Contiguous position states');same(a['velocity_start_m_s'][1:],a['velocity_endpoint_m_s'][:-1],'Contiguous velocity states')
  same(a['velocity_start_m_s'][0],compiled['initial_qvel'],'Initial velocity');same(a['position_start_m'][0],compiled['body_pos_m'][1]+compiled['initial_qpos'],'Initial world position')
  close(a['qpos_endpoint']+compiled['body_pos_m'][1],a['position_endpoint_m'],'Endpoint qpos/world binding');same(a['qvel_endpoint'],a['velocity_endpoint_m_s'],'Endpoint qvel/world binding')
  for key in ('engine_ncon','engine_nefc','engine_qfrc_constraint','warning_counts'):need(not np.any(a[key]),'No engine contacts/forces/warnings '+key)
  law,lerrors=law_from_operands(a,p['parameters'],compiled);mechanics,ierrors=integration_from_operands(case,a,law,p['parameters'])
  assessment_expected=assessment(case,a,p['limits'],p['parameters']);actual=row['measurement']['assessment']
  need(assessment_expected['status']==actual['status'] and assessment_expected['failures']==actual['failures'],'Independent qualification decisions')
  need(set(assessment_expected['metrics'])==set(actual['metrics']),'Metric inventory')
  for key,value in assessment_expected['metrics'].items():close(np.asarray(actual['metrics'][key]),np.asarray(value),'Analytic metric '+key)
  need(row['measurement']['valid_endpoint_samples']==n,'Endpoint denominator')
  same(np.asarray(row['measurement']['final_position_world_m']),a['position_endpoint_m'][-1],'Final position scalar');same(np.asarray(row['measurement']['final_velocity_world_m_s']),a['velocity_endpoint_m_s'][-1],'Final velocity scalar')
  cases.append(dict(case=case,assessment=assessment_expected,intervals_verified=n,law_maximum_replay_errors=lerrors,integration_maximum_replay_errors=ierrors,
   maximum_abs_discrete_energy_defect_J=float(np.max(np.abs(mechanics['measured_integration_defect_J']))),sum_discrete_defect_J=float(mechanics['measured_integration_defect_J'].sum()),
   sum_continuous_dissipation_J=float(mechanics['continuous_dissipation_step_J'].sum()),physical_outcome=None))
 comparisons=convergence(r['cases']);need(comparisons==r['timestep_comparisons'],'Independent timestep comparisons/unchanged gates')
 qualified=all(x['assessment']['status']=='PASS' for x in cases) and all(x['status']=='PASS' for x in comparisons)
 need(r['numerical_compliant_contact_qualification']==('PASS' if qualified else 'NOT_QUALIFIED'),'No fabricated qualification')
 verify(p['bindings']);need(git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==FREEZE,'HEAD hold after')
 for name,info in inventory.items():need(sha(name)==info['sha256'] and Path(name).stat().st_size==info['bytes'],'Output unchanged after readback')
 receipt=dict(schema_version='manosim_compliant_contact_independent_saved_readback_v1',status='VERIFIED_COMPLETED_COMPLIANT_CONTACT_BENCHMARK',freeze_commit=FREEZE,
  active_protocol_sha256=PSHA,report_sha256=sha(rp),expected_bindings=1163,selected_Git_blob_count=86,all_bindings_verified_before=True,all_bindings_verified_after=True,
  numerical_compliant_contact_qualification=r['numerical_compliant_contact_qualification'],operation_counts=r['operation_counts'],intervals_independently_verified=sum(x['intervals_verified'] for x in cases),
  artifact_inventory=inventory,array_inventory=array_inventory,cases=cases,timestep_comparisons=comparisons,verification_model_FK_contact_law_or_physics_calls=0,
  physical_outcome=None,**{key:False for key in FLAGS},errors=[],
  scope='Explicit frozen Kelvin-Voigt/regularized Coulomb3translation analytic fixtures only; virtualwork and continuous dissipation do not force discrete energy defect tozero; not native hand/contact geometry or physical calibration',
  verifier_source=Path(__file__).read_text(),verifier_source_sha256=sha(__file__))
 out=BASE/'run_v1/independent_readback.json'
 with out.open('x') as stream:json.dump(receipt,stream,sort_keys=True,indent=2,allow_nan=False);stream.write('\n')
 print(json.dumps(dict(status=receipt['status'],qualification=receipt['numerical_compliant_contact_qualification'],intervals=27000,cases=[x['assessment']['status'] for x in cases],comparisons=[x['status'] for x in comparisons],sha256=sha(out))))
if __name__=='__main__':main()
